column1: # Each row is one buildable "lane": a kernel source + an OpenHarmony release
# branch + a BOARD + a system type.  Every kernel version was read out of the
# remote's own Makefile, and every board was read out of OpenHarmony's own
# WHY A ROW IS NOT JUST (source, branch)
# A kernel built from a generic configuration is not usable on a device.
# OpenHarmony's configuration repository ships a per-board configuration for
# each target, and a boardless build has no GPU driver, no Wi-Fi, no board
# pin/mux, no touch controller: the 6.6 rk3568 configuration alone carries 24
# CONFIG_MALI_BIFROST* entries with MALI_PLATFORM_NAME="rk" that a boardless
# build does not get.  So `board` is a required dimension, not a hint, and a
# lane with an empty board is only ever useful for a generic or CI build.
# Columns (TAB separated; 1-11, the last two may be empty):
#   5 ohos_branch OpenHarmony release branch this lane tracks
#   6 kver        kernel version string read from that branch's Makefile
#   7 overlay     config overlay dir under configs/lanes/<overlay>/
#  10 board       board layer in kernel_linux_config ('' = none, generic build)
#  11 arch        target ARCH override; empty means derived from the repository
